Leaf shader-property stream builder. Emits one 0x10-stride STSP stream with four components per vertex.

[2026-10-03 owned-stream correction] Verified same one-stream ABI as Fallout CreateRendererSpecificProperty 0x828CE150: virtual +6C supplies STSPData+8 and +70 supplies ushort count +C through retained property+A4. One 16-byte/4-component stream, copyData=false. The plugin no longer needs a 128-entry auxiliary property cache; native leaf fallback is layout-compatible, not a different declaration. Current adapter reads owner metadata each request and rejects invalid/overflowing spans before allocation. Native lifetime remains governed by the retained STSPData.

[v150 leaf normal map audit] Verified native leaf AdditionalGeometryData has one FLOAT4 STSP stream (stride10, descriptor0), no T/B streams. RT4.1 SourceCode/LeafGeometry.cpp702-729 exports four corner N/T/B vectors for dynamic leaves. Normal-mapped card support must carry these into a compatible native declaration; v150 does not yet change this native method.

[v151 normal-card integration] Property vtable slotA92A60 (+94) is wrapped only for plugin-tagged normal STSP owners. Ordinary owners still call original method. Tagged owners hold three planar FLOAT4 streams: native wind/selector, tangent/normal-enable, binormal. Native property clones retain that STSP and continue using the same global property vtable, so future stream rebuilds must preserve all three streams. Plugin-owned input blocks are copied into AdditionalGeometryData; clone/game execution UNVERIFIED.

Build leaf auxiliary input stream: one float4 per vertex, stride 0x10. Stock builder field z contains integer LeafBase selector plus packed-green fractional dimmer.
SpeedTreeOBSE v167 integration: existing A92A60 stream-builder hook recognizes the new paired leaf owner. It creates four owned float4 AGD streams: unchanged native STSP0, optional normal bases1/2, and pair3. Prefix stream+8/count+C remains compatible with native leaf consumers and owned publication.
